security_audit.summary: The static alerts are overwhelmingly false positives from Markdown fenced examples, placeholder URLs, and documentation snippets for environment variables. I found no prompt injection, secret exfiltration, malicious network behavior, or executable helper scripts in SKILL.md. The author should clarify sample secrets and global CLI install examples so users do not copy unsafe placeholders into production.

remediation.suggestion: Replace values such as user/pass and pass with invalid placeholders and add a warning to use managed secrets.
Add guidance to verify CLI packages and prefer project-local tools or npx where practical.
State that .env.production and .env.local examples are templates and must not contain committed secrets.

content.value_statement: React deployment setup can be repetitive and error prone. This skill provides practical examples for Vercel, Netlify, Docker, CI/CD, environments, and monitoring.
actual_capabilities: Generate Vercel and Netlify deployment configs for React build outputs.
Draft Dockerfile, nginx, and Docker Compose examples for static React apps.
Create GitHub Actions workflows for builds, tests, previews, and production deploys.
Map Vite and Next.js environment variable patterns for client and server code.
Recommend build analysis, code splitting, caching, health checks, and Sentry setup.
limitations: Examples must be adapted to each hosting account, domain, and repository structure.
It does not create accounts, manage billing, or grant deployment permissions.
Secrets must be supplied by the user through trusted platform settings.
It focuses on React, Vite, and Next.js deployment patterns.

use_cases.title: Standardize React deployment recipes
use_cases.description: Create repeatable Vercel, Netlify, Docker, and GitHub Actions guidance for product teams.

use_cases.title: Prepare a production build
use_cases.description: Set environment variables, SPA routing, security headers, and build checks before release.

use_cases.title: Ship preview environments
use_cases.description: Add pull request previews and comments so reviewers can test changes before merge.

prompt_templates.title: Create a deployment checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production deployment checklist for my React app using Vite and Vercel. Include build, environment, security, and rollback items.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Netlify hosting
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me configure Netlify for a React single page app. Include build settings, redirects, headers, and environment variables.

prompt_templates.title: Build Docker deployment assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Docker deployment plan for a static React app with nginx, SPA fallback, caching, and optional backend services.

prompt_templates.title: Design CI/CD with previews
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow for a React app with tests, preview deploys, production deploys, health checks, and Sentry tracking.

output_examples.input: A Vite React app needs Vercel deployment with environment variables and SPA routing.
output_examples.output: A concise plan covering build command, output directory, preview behavior, environment names, security headers, and verification checks.

output_examples.input: A team wants Docker deployment for a static React bundle.
output: Compose notes for optional API and database services.

output_examples.input: A repository needs pull request preview deployments.
output_examples.output: A workflow outline with checkout, dependency install, tests, deploy preview, and pull request comment steps.

best_practices: Keep deployment secrets in platform secret stores, not in committed files or shared prompts.
Run tests and local production builds before creating a production deploy.
Document environment variable ownership for client, server, preview, and production contexts.
anti_patterns: Do not commit real .env files or database credentials to the repository.
Do not reuse sample passwords or placeholder hosts in production deployments.
Do not deploy without SPA fallback, security headers, and rollback verification.

faq.question: Does this skill only support React?
faq.answer: It focuses on React apps, with examples for Vite and Next.js deployment patterns.

faq.question: Can it deploy for me?
faq.answer: It can guide commands and configuration, but account access and final deployment approval stay with the user.

faq.question: Does it handle secrets?
faq.answer: It explains where secrets belong, but users must provide values through trusted platform settings.

faq.question: Which hosts are covered?
faq.answer: The guide covers Vercel, Netlify, Docker, nginx, GitHub Actions, and related monitoring setup.

faq.question: Can it help with preview deployments?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes pull request preview workflows and guidance for posting preview URLs.

faq.question: Can it optimize builds?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers bundle analysis, route splitting, manual chunks, caching, and production checks.
